citation_short: Saeedi, Saeedi, Maghsoudi & Shalbaf 2021, Cognitive Neurodynamics
dataset: Mumtaz et al. (2017) public MDD dataset (HUSM; figshare EEG_Data_New)
connectivity_measure: GPDC (generalized partial directed coherence) and dDTF (direct directed transfer function); MVAR-based effective connectivity (Granger family)
frequency_bands: 8: delta 1-4, theta 4-7, alpha/mu 8-12, beta1 12-15, beta2 15-22, beta3 22-30, beta 12-30, gamma 30-70 Hz
other_metrics: 1DCNN-LSTM: sensitivity 98.519+/-2.457, specificity 100, F1 99.05+/-0.94, precision 98.14+/-1.85. Others: 2DCNN-LSTM 96.415, 2DCNN 96.226, 1DCNN 95.283, LSTM 89.057

citation_short: Guo, Pei, Yao, Yan, Song & Li 2025, Sensors
n_subjects: 122 recruited; 2 excluded for incomplete information; 120 analysed
connectivity_measure: PLV between sLORETA source-space ROI signals (-> clustering coefficient, local efficiency); Pearson correlation between ROI signals thresholded at 0.3 as the GCN adjacency matrix
architecture: sLORETA cortical source reconstruction (CFE) -> 4-layer multi-head self-attention Transformer (FA) -> GCN -> focal adversarial domain adaptation (Focal Loss + gradient reversal layer + center loss)
other_metrics: F1 83.42, recall 85.56, precision 84.05; TPR 85.57, FPR 14.82; confusion matrix DP 5904/996 and HC 1645/9455; ablation S1-S8 range 75.81-85.33; scalp-vs-source ablation 79.00 vs 85.33
extraction_notes: 64 Ag/AgCl electrodes at 500 Hz; 50 Hz notch, 4-80 Hz band-pass, downsampled to 250 Hz, FASTER artifact removal, z-score per channel. Each participant's recording cut into 150 epochs of 2 s -> 6900 DP + 11100 HC = 18000 epochs. 15002-vertex source space mapped to 68 Desikan-Killiany ROIs. PAPER ERRORS: Table 1 lists 'Postcentral' twice (IDs 21 and 23) and is captioned left-hemisphere with 34 rows though 68 ROIs are used; Section 3.5 text says CFE raised ACC 'from 57.81% to 79.80%' but Table 6 row S1 gives 75.81.

dataset: Mumtaz et al. (2017) public MDD dataset (HUSM; figshare EEG_Data_New/4244171)
connectivity_measure: normalized mutual information between channel pairs -> multilayer brain network (one layer per band); top 30% of edges by weight retained in each layer
frequency_bands: 5 constructed: delta 0.5-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 31-60 Hz; final classifier uses the beta and gamma layers only
architecture: AM-CNN: two parallel branches (one per retained band), each with two attention-mechanism feature-extraction modules (conv-conv-GAP-dense-dense-multiply-conv-BN), then concatenate + 5x5 conv + 1x1 conv + flatten + softmax
other_metrics: sensitivity 97.62, specificity 96.77, F-measure 0.9734; single-band F-measure beta 0.9244 and gamma 0.9419
extraction_notes: 19 channels at 256 Hz; both eyes-closed and eyes-open files used. First 180 s of each file cut into 90 samples by 2-s non-overlapping windows -> 5130 HC + 5580 MDD samples. Ten-fold CV, 90/10 train/test with 10% of training held out for validation; 40 epochs, batch 128, lr 0.001. Network measures reported: weighted average clustering coefficient and graph energy.

citation_short: Khan, Yahya, Kamel & Faye 2021, IEEE Access
dataset: HUSM cohort, described as part of the data in Mumtaz et al. 2017 (PLoS ONE); obtained from the CISIR repository, available on request
connectivity_measure: partial directed coherence (PDC), MVAR-based effective connectivity, computed over 19 channels then reduced to 6 default-mode-network electrodes (F3, F4, P3, P4, Fz, Pz)

architecture: 3D CNN: three 3D conv + batch norm + ReLU blocks, global average pooling, dropout 0.2, fully connected softmax
